entities.name: Minamo
entities.description: Blue-aligned wizard academy built around and above Lake Kamitaki on Kamigawa, where the kami first manifested in the Kami War.

entities.name: Kamitaki Falls
entities.description: Kamigawa's largest waterfall, holding a curtain between the material and spirit worlds.

entities.name: Soratami
entities.description: Moonfolk who lead Minamo and pursue a secret agenda.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: Ogre who ravaged Minamo to avenge his pupil Kobo.

entities.name: Kobo
entities.description: Hyozan Reckoner and apprentice of Hidetsugu, killed by Choryu.

entities.name: Choryu
entities.description: Minamo student and friend of Princess Michiko Konda who killed Kobo.

entities.name: Keiga
entities.description: Guardian dragon of Minamo, defeated by Hidetsugu.

entities.name: Kairi
entities.description: Reincarnation of the Tide Star who refuses to guard Otawara.

entities.name: Iki Hisoka
entities.description: Headmaster of Minamo, killed by Hidetsugu.

entities.name: Mariko
entities.description: Niece of the Brothers Yamazaki, said to study at the rebuilt Minamo.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War in which Minamo became a frontline.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: Combatant in a battle that further destroyed the academy.

entities.name: All-Consuming Oni of Chaos
entities.description: Opponent of O-Kagachi in the battle that destroyed Minamo's remains.

entities.name: Hyozan Reckoners
entities.description: Ogre order bound by the Hyozan oath.

events.summary: At the outbreak of the Kami War Minamo becomes a frontline as kami emerge from the Falls.
events.quote: At the outbreak of the war, Minamo became a frontline

events.summary: Choryu kills Kobo, apprentice of Hidetsugu.
events.quote: made a grave mistake when he killed Kobo

events.summary: Hidetsugu attacks Minamo, defeats Keiga, destroys the academy and decapitates Hisoka.
events.quote: defeated the guardian dragon Keiga , and destroyed the academy

events.summary: What remained of the academy is destroyed in the battle between O-Kagachi and the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos.
events.quote: Whatever was left of the Academy was further destroyed in the battle between O-Kagachi and the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos .

events.summary: After the war Minamo is rebuilt, but later declines and is replaced by Otawara.
events.quote: After the war, the Minamo School was rebuilt

relations.quote: Minamo is led by the Soratami
Hisoka himself was decapitated (and consumed) by Hidetsugu.
